calls.statement:
SELECT 
  f.sale_date,
  f.channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
GROUP BY f.sale_date, f.channel_code
ORDER BY f.sale_date DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT DISTINCT channel_code, channel_id
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
LIMIT 20;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) as min_date,
  MAX(sale_date) as max_date,
  COUNT(*) as total_web_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3);

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(f.net_amount) > 0
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  MIN(net_amount) as min_net_amount,
  MAX(net_amount) as max_net_amount,
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN net_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_lines
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
  AND channel_id IN (2, 3);

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as web_sales_before_migration
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
  AND f.sale_date < '2025-11-03';

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(f.net_amount) DESC
LIMIT 10;
